name: Logging Producer
helpText: Logs the result of calling toString() on any Java object. It produces no downstream payload.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.

replacementText.helpText: Used in conjunction with regExpPattern, anything that matches regExpPattern will be replace with this replacementText.

regExpPattern.helpText: Used in conjunction with replacementText, anything matching this regexp pattern will be replace by replacementText.
